origin: Deep within the burning labyrinth, the Minotaur waits — not to overpower you, but to outlast you.
story: It does not grow weaker with each visit. You simply learn the way out.
quotes: The Minotaur never becomes weaker. You simply learn the way out.
unlockText: The Wilds begin. Somewhere ahead, the labyrinth is already burning.
victoryText: The ladder is climbed. The Minotaur does not rise again — not today.
rule: Choose your weight, then finish without skipping a single rep. The ladder does not forgive shortcuts.
hunterAdvice: The Minotaur never becomes weaker. You simply learn the way out.
